AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To measure patterns of clinical activity at colposcopy before and after vaccinated women entered the Scottish Cervical Screening Programme (SCSP).

AbstractText.Label: DESIGN
AbstractText.content: Population-based observational study using nationally collected data.

AbstractText.Label: SAMPLE
AbstractText.content: All women with a date of birth on or after 1 January 1985 who attended colposcopy in Scotland between 2008 and 2014.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: Routinely collected data from the Scottish National Colposcopy Clinical Information Audit System (NCCIAS) were extracted, including: referral criteria, referral cervical cytology, colposcopic findings, clinical procedures, and histology results. Analysis was restricted to those referred to colposcopy at age 20 or 21 years.

AbstractText.Label: MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES
AbstractText.content: Referral criteria, positive predictive value of colposcopy, default rates, and rates of cervical biopsies and treatments.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: A total of 7372 women referred for colposcopy at age 20 or 21 years were identified. There was a downward trend in the proportion of those referred with abnormal cytology (2008/9, 91.0%; 2013/14, 90.3%; linear trend P = 0.03). Women were less likely to have diagnostic or therapeutic interventions. The proportion with no biopsy (2008/9, 19.5%; 2013/14, 26.9%; linear trend P < 0.0001) and no treatment (2008/9, 74.9%; 2013/14, 91.8%; linear trend P < 0.0001) increased over the period of observation.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSIONS
AbstractText.content: A reduction in clinical activity related to abnormal screening referrals is likely to be associated with the human papillomavirus (HPV) catch-up immunisation programme. Referral criteria and the service provision of colposcopy needs to be planned carefully, taking account of the increasing number of women who have been immunised against HPV that will be entering cervical screening programmes worldwide.

AbstractText.Label: TWEETABLE ABSTRACT
AbstractText.content: Colposcopy referral criteria and service planning need attention following HPV immunisation programme.
